metadata.title: The global structure of bi-rotational self-expanders
metadata.abstract: We describe the self-expanders of the mean curvature flow in $\mathbb{R}^{p+q+2}$ invariant under $O(p+1)\times O(q+1)$. Apart from the Clifford minimal cone, every such hypersurface is complete, proper and noncompact, and belongs to one of three families: two one-parameter families of embedded hypersurfaces diffeomorphic to $\mathbb{R}^{p+1}\times\mathbb{S}^{q}$ or to $\mathbb{R}^{q+1}\times\mathbb{S}^{p}$, whose profile curves leave an axis, and a two-parameter family diffeomorphic to $\mathbb{R}\times\mathbb{S}^{p}\times\mathbb{S}^{q}$, parametrized by the point of the profile curve closest to the origin, which is the generic family: its set of initial conditions is open and of full measure in the phase space. Every end is asymptotically conical, with explicit decay rates, and every such hypersurface has Euclidean volume growth. A profile curve of the third family has at most one loop, and the point of the curve closest to the origin lies on that loop.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 描述双旋转自膨胀子的三类轮廓族，除 Clifford 极小锥外均完备、正常且非紧，端部渐近锥并具显式衰减率及欧氏体积增长。
analysis.breakthrough: 给出与同作者自收缩子研究明显不同的整体有序图景。
analysis.limitations: 前两族为嵌入模型，第三族不能自动称为全部嵌入；结论依赖双旋转对称。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 Claude 与 ChatGPT 辅助语言和表述组织、数值试验、部分论证建议及计算讨论核验；明确数值计算未经认证，证明不依赖这些图。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25833v1 · 第6页 AI statement 及 Data availability

analysis.priorityReason: 适合平均曲率流奇性解消及锥端模型研究。
